summary.text: Fitzgerald Mofor is a Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 9A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and works in government affairs.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he named tax relief for middle-class families, lower energy costs, and upgrading aging infrastructure while protecting agricultural communities as his key campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Fitzgerald Mofor graduated from Sherwood High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Alabama at Birmingham in 2019 and a graduate degree from Washington University Law School in 2022, and his career experience includes working in government affairs.
In 2024, he ran in the nonpartisan primary for the Montgomery County Board of Education At-large seat, receiving 5.2 percent of the vote and not advancing.
Mofor advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary for District 9A.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Mofor said he is passionate about budget appropriations and tax policy and wants to influence Maryland's Budget and Reconciliation Financing Act.
He listed endorsements from former state senator Gail Bates, former delegate Trent Kittleman and Delegate Ric Metzgar, among others.
